Extract NON-FICTION entities (people, organizations, technical terms).

Return ONLY a JSON array (not an object wrapper, just the raw array):
[
  {
    "name": "Entity Name or Term",
    "role_or_def": "Role/title or definition",
    "notes": "Additional context",
    "first_seen": "Location first mentioned"
  }
]

No hallucinations. Output ONLY the JSON array, nothing else.
